procedural_matters: IRL 5270 (Bow 26) was represented by Conor Haughton.
Race Committee was represented by Sean Semmens.
Daniel Gibbons (Pin end boat) gave evidence as a witness for the race committee.
Daniel Gibbons (Pin end boat) provided video/audio evidence.
facts: In race 3 black flag was displayed as the preparatory signal.
Just before the start, the race committee identified IRL 5270's (Bow 26) hull in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark.
IRL 5270 was scored BFD in race 3.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
